title: Sensor-Driven Mission Synthesis for UAV/UGV Swarms: A TB-CSPN Coordination Architecture with Hardware-Enforced Safety
abstract: arXiv:2608.14306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a coordination architecture for heterogeneous UAV/UGV swarms that synthesises mission actions from uncertain, multi-modal sensor evidence while preserving hardware-enforced safety at the actuation boundary. The approach combines radar, RF, acoustic, and visual observations with Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB-CSPN) orchestration to support incremental mission formation under partial and evolving information. Consultant agents transform sensor outputs into temporally bounded semantic tokens, while supervisor agents provide authorisation and policy-governed release of mission transitions. This separation between interpretation, coordination, and execution yields auditable decision paths, constrains non-determinism within the coordination layer through guards and synchronisation, and enables bounded-time integration of heterogeneous evidence. translated_title: 基于传感器驱动的无人机/无人地面车辆集群任务合成：一种具有硬件强化安全性的TB-CSPN协调架构
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种异构无人机/无人地面车辆集群的协调架构，该架构从不确定的多模态传感器证据中合成任务动作，同时在执行边界保持硬件强化的安全性。该方法将雷达、射频、声学和视觉观测与基于主题的通信空间Petri网（TB-CSPN）编排相结合，以支持在部分和不断演变的信息下进行增量任务形成。顾问代理将传感器输出转换为时间有界的语义标记，而监督代理提供授权和政策管理的任务转换释放。这种解释、协调和执行之间的分离产生了可审计的决策路径，通过守卫和同步约束协调层内的非确定性，并实现异构证据的有界时间集成。为了提高在对抗环境（包括网络）中的韧性，该架构还考虑了相应的鲁棒性措施。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合TB-CSPN协调与硬件强化安全的异构无人机/无人地面车辆集群架构，通过顾问和监督代理分离实现基于不确定多模态传感器证据的可审计、有界时间任务合成。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a heterogeneous UAV/UGV swarm architecture combining TB-CSPN coordination with hardware-enforced safety, achieving auditable, bounded-time mission synthesis from uncertain multi-modal sensor evidence through separated consultant and supervisor agents.
